subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: After the compaction-reset defect is fixed, what real behavior proof should be required before merging this external retry/session-state PR?
rationale: The remaining proof question spans provider retry ordering, session-state safety, and message delivery side effects, which cannot be settled from the current extracted transcript and mocked tests alone.

options.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact from a real runner/gateway setup showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicated tool/message side effects after the code fix.

options.title: Accept extracted proof after code fix
options.body: Maintainership could intentionally accept the temporary-script transcript plus focused tests as enough, but that leaves less confidence in the real delivery path.

options.title: Pick another canonical candidate
options.body: If another open PR is preferred, pause this branch after preserving any useful tests or proof context.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or an artifact from a real runner/gateway setup showing the retry warning, recovered reply, and no duplicated tool/message side effects after the code fix.
